title: Mid-level data engineer (Spark/Airflow/dbt/Snowflake)
description: A 4-year Python/Spark/Airflow/dbt/Snowflake data engineer evaluated against 8 postings: one strong match with streaming/IaC gaps, one adjacent analytics-engineering match, one staffing-agency keyword trap stuffed with the exact data stack, one marginal Python backend role, and four distractors.
rationale: j3 is the constructed keyword trap: a staffing-agency sourcer role whose posting is saturated with the resume's exact stack tokens (Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Python) yet belongs to the recruiting job family, so it is graded 0 — TF-IDF will over-rank it and the hybrid matcher should not. j1 is the gap target: it overlaps strongly on Python, Spark, Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake (justifying grade 3) while requiring Kafka and Terraform, which the resume clearly lacks (high-severity gaps), plus preferred Databricks and Great Expectations (low). j2 (analytics engineer on dbt/Snowflake/SQL) is an adjacent-family good match at grade 2. j4 probes the graded boundary: a Python backend role with real Python/SQL overlap but a different core stack and job family, hence grade 1. The remaining four jobs (frontend, iOS, product marketing, SRE) share at most non-core tokens with the resume and are graded 0.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Data Engineer — Lakestone Analytics (Remote, US)

Lakestone Analytics provides demand forecasting for consumer brands. Our warehouse ingests billions of events a month and we are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own the pipelines behind it.

What you will do:
- Own batch and streaming pipelines feeding our Snowflake warehouse
- Design and review dbt model architecture and coding standards
- Build streaming ingestion on Kafka for near-real-time forecasting
- Provision and manage data infrastructure with Terraform

Requirements: Python, Apache Spark, Snowflake, Kafka, Terraform. 4+ years building production data pipelines and 1+ years operating streaming ingestion at scale. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have: Databricks, Great Expectations, Looker.

Data Engineering Recruiter / Talent Sourcer — StackScout Staffing (Onsite, Chicago IL)

StackScout places contract data engineers with enterprise clients. We need a sourcer who knows the modern data stack cold: Apache Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Python, Kafka — if you can spot the difference between a Spark tuning expert and a dashboard analyst from a resume, we want you.

You will source and screen candidates for client data teams, run Boolean searches across job boards for Spark, Airflow, Snowflake and dbt keywords, and maintain the contractor pipeline in our ATS.

Requirements: keyword sourcing for data roles involving Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake and Python; Boolean search; ATS tooling (Bullhorn or Greenhouse). 1+ years in agency recruiting or sourcing.
